world_offer_label: the Alexandrian catechetical world of Clement, Origen, and the Christian-philosophical school
_comment: Primary-text translations and secondary scholarship drawn from this world's own vetted Source Registry / Doc_02, curated for a participant who wants to go deeper after talking with this world's Representative.

resources.title: Origen: Contra Celsum
resources.author: Henry Chadwick (trans.)
resources.note: The standard English translation of Origen's great apologetic work answering the pagan critic Celsus — direct access to the intellectual, philosophically fluent voice this world's Representative carries forward.

resources.title: Clement of Alexandria: Christ the Educator
resources.author: Simon P. Wood (trans.)
resources.publisher: Catholic University of America Press (Fathers of the Church)
resources.note: A translation of Clement's Paedagogus, his own explicitly catechetical work on Christian formation as gradual transformation — the clearest primary window into how this world actually taught.

resources.title: Early Christian Thought and the Classical Tradition: Studies in Justin, Clement, and Origen
resources.author: Henry Chadwick
resources.note: The standard account of how Clement and Origen engaged and refused Greek philosophy — the central intellectual move this world's Representative makes constantly.

resources.title: Biblical Exegesis and the Formation of Christian Culture
resources.author: Frances M. Young
resources.note: The leading treatment of how patristic biblical interpretation functioned as formation, not just scholarship — directly relevant to this world's allegorical, multilevel reading of Scripture.

resources.title: The Origins of the Christian Mystical Tradition: From Plato to Denys
resources.author: Andrew Louth
resources.note: Traces how Clement's and Origen's synthesis of Platonism and Scripture became the root of later Christian contemplative theology — good for a participant drawn to this world's language of purification, illumination, and union.

resources.title: Arius: Heresy and Tradition
resources.author: Rowan Williams
resources.note: Situates Arius within, not against, the Origenian Alexandrian theological tradition — useful for a participant curious how this world's own intellectual method led toward the controversy that followed it.
